command: set -euo pipefail; LA="$HOME/local-agent"; WT="$HOME/local-agent-v4.11.2-doc-contract-staging"; SHA=c0aba18a65f98fa7697e1f884d605027d70f8cd9; test "$(git -C "$LA" branch --show-current)" = main; test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"; test -z "$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; REMOTE_STAGING=$(git -C "$LA" ls-remote origin refs/heads/v4.11.2-doc-contract-staging | cut -f1); test "$REMOTE_STAGING" = "$SHA"; if git -C "$LA" rev-parse -q --verify refs/tags/v4.11.2 >/dev/null; then test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse 'v4.11.2^{}')" = "$SHA"; else git -C "$LA" tag -a v4.11.2 "$SHA" -m 'local-agent v4.11.2'; fi; git -C "$LA" push origin refs/tags/v4.11.2; test "$(git -C "$LA" ls-remote origin 'refs/tags/v4.11.2^{}' | cut -f1)" = "$SHA"; if [ -e "$WT/.git" ]; then test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"; git -C "$LA" worktree remove "$WT"; fi; git -C "$LA" worktree prune; if git -C "$LA" show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/v4.11.2-doc-contract-staging; then test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse refs/heads/v4.11.2-doc-contract-staging)" = "$SHA"; git -C "$LA" branch -D v4.11.2-doc-contract-staging; fi; git -C "$LA" push origin --delete v4.11.2-doc-contract-staging; test -z "$(git -C "$LA" ls-remote origin refs/heads/v4.11.2-doc-contract-staging)"; test ! -e "$WT"; test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse 'v4.11.2^{}')" = "$SHA"; test -z "$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; ! ps -axo command= | grep -F "$WT" | grep -v grep; printf 'v4.11.2 tag and staging cleanup OK\n'
